hooks.name: harmoglyph-engine-verification
hooks.description: Run typecheck, composition and timeline tests plus 5×100 seeded PBT checks after engine file saves. Kiro runtime execution still needs independent verification.

action.command: npm run lint && npm run test:composition && node --import tsx --test src/engine/compositionTimeline.test.ts && node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "import { runPbtInvariants } from './src/engine/pbtSuite.ts'; const checks = runPbtInvariants(20261116, 100); console.log(JSON.stringify(checks.map(({ id, passed, passedCount, trials }) => ({ id, passed, passedCount, trials })), null, 2)); if (checks.length !== 5 || checks.some(c => !c.passed || c.trials !== 100)) process.exit(1);"
